title: The programme begins with formalism and ends with L-functions

This is direct evidence for the README's SGA 4/5 placement, while these opening pages do not by themselves substantiate a developed SGA 7 monodromy argument. The later supplied lead that the author prefers to complete the formalism before applications restates this priority, although scan order cannot establish the sheets' dates.

title: The GAGA margin needs an algebraic constructibility convention
body: The asserted “équivalence des catégories” of algebraic and analytic constructible torsion sheaves needs its constructibility convention or a properness hypothesis recovered. Under the usual local analytic-stratification convention, on $\mathbb C$ the finite-coefficient sheaf supported on the closed discrete analytic set $\mathbb Z=V(\sin\pi z)$ is analytically constructible, whereas its support is not an algebraically constructible subset of $\mathbb A^1_{\mathbb C}$. This is a conditional scope test for the isolated margin, not a claim that an algebraically stratified comparison theorem is false.

title: Wild coefficients obstruct the unrestricted open-immersion extension
body: If the proposed finite-type extension is read with unrestricted torsion, take $j:\mathbb G_m\hookrightarrow\mathbb A^1$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p$ and coefficients $\mathbb F_p$. At the origin the Artin–Schreier classes $t^{-m}$, for $m>0$ prime to $p$, are linearly independent in the punctured strict-local $H^1$: a nonzero negative-valuation term $h^p-h$ has pole order divisible by $p$. The resulting infinite stalk of $R^1j_*\mathbb F_p$ prevents constructibility, so the purity restriction is essential even on a smooth curve where resolution itself is not the issue.

title: Connected fibres versus geometrically connected fibres

Its fibre over the real point is connected, but after geometric base change the trace is addition $A^2\to A$, which is not an isomorphism for nonzero $A$. This tests the missing convention and supports recovering geometric connectedness, while leaving the words on the page unchanged.
